Pull blocks from the upstream peer up to its tip, or on with `--follow`

Usage: dolos sync catchup [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --follow           Keep following the chain once the upstream tip is committed
      --stop-epoch <N>   Stop once the ledger reaches this epoch, on its first block: the only state
                         a Stelae snapshot of that epoch is cut from
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
